models.architecture_or_algorithm: PyAMPA包含5个模块：AMPScreen（基于滑动窗口的倾向性评分，识别抗菌区域）、AMPValidate（基于随机森林分类器，使用2-mer向量化验证AMP）、AMPSolve（随机森林分类器预测溶血、毒性；随机森林回归器预测对11种菌株的抗菌活性；基于多变量回归模型预测半衰期）、AMPMutate（系统点突变扫描）、AMPOptimize（遗传算法优化多目标适应度，包括抗菌活性、半衰期和溶血性）
models.input_features: 氨基酸序列，提取2-mer特征，以及序列中非极性氨基酸比例、Trp/Tyr存在与否、等电点等
models.dataset_source_or_link: AMPlify dataset, Liu et al. CPP database, AMPDeep hemolytic database, ToxinPred toxicity database, GRAMPA database (https://github.com/zswitten/Antimicrobial-Peptides)
models.candidate_reason: PyAMPA是一个集筛选、验证、性质预测和优化于一体的AMP发现平台，具有高通量蛋白组扫描能力，内部采用随机森林和遗传算法，预测抗菌、溶血、毒性、半衰期等多维性质，并提供了实验验证。适合作为AMP预测benchmark中的综合性工具。

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Not specified; prediction algorithm for detecting cryptic antimicrobial segments in proteins
models.candidate_reason: AMPA is a computational tool for predicting antimicrobial regions in protein sequences, directly applicable to AMP prediction benchmarks.

datasets.evidence: AMPs were retrieved from the AMPlify data set of experimentally validated AMPs. The data set contains 6,676 peptides, evenly split into 3,338 AMPs and 3,338 non-AMPs.
IC50 data were retrieved from the Giant Repository of AMP Activities (GRAMPA) (https://github.com/zswitten/Antimicrobial-Peptides).

datasets.dataset_source: Liu et al. cell-penetrating peptide database
datasets.evidence: For cell-penetrating peptides (CPPs), the Liu et al. database was used, containing 924 sequences, of which 462 positive and 462 negative CPPs.
To predict hemolytic peptides, we used the AMPDeep database of 7,180 peptides, of which 3,007 hemolytic and 4,173 non-hemolytic.
For toxicity prediction, we used the ToxinPred database, with 3,613 peptides, of which 1,156 toxic and 2,457 non-toxic.

metrics.evidence: Accuracy and Mathew’s correlation coefficient (MCC) were used as indicators of global performance.
Accuracy and Mathew’s correlation coefficient (MCC) were used as indicators of global performance.
The area under the ROC curve (AUROC) and area under the PR curve (AUPR) were used as an indicator of the classification performance.
The area under the ROC curve (AUROC) and area under the PR curve (AUPR) were used as an indicator of the classification performance.
The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) was defined as the lowest concentration of the test peptide at which microorganism growth was visibly absent.
Hemoglobin release was then measured as OD at 540 nm. Percent hemolysis was calculated.

important_evidence: PyAMPA is a novel platform for AMP discovery consisting of five modules: AMPScreen, AMPValidate, AMPSolve, AMPMutate, AMPOptimize. It enables high-throughput proteome inspection and optimization. Code: https://github.com/SysBioUAB/PyAMPA
PyAMPA was trained on AMPlify, CPP, AMPDeep, ToxinPred, GRAMPA datasets and evaluated on 10 novel peptides experimentally.
AMPA (AntiMicrobial Peptide Analyzer) is a prediction algorithm for detecting cryptic antimicrobial segments in proteins, with web server: http://tcoffee.crg.cat/apps/ampa
Performance metrics used: Accuracy, MCC, AUROC, AUPR, MIC, Hemolysis.
uncertainties: AMPA training data and algorithm details not reported; only web server link available.
PyAMPA model weights are not provided; only source code and datasets are available.
Several regex-extracted datasets (e.g., 'PyAMPA.', 'PyAMPA.<h4') are likely noise and excluded.
Relationship between PyAMPA and AMPA is unclear; they share the name 'AMPA' but appear to be different tools.
Some non-AMP related papers were included in the retrieval batch (ECG, gaming, transformers) and are marked as unrelated.
